page_title: CRE 2-0 LEC | Cremonese v Lecce 07/12/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' The referee blows his whistle for the final time to end this match.
90+5' Lecce have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
90+5' Lecce can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
90+4' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Lecce.
90+3' A precise low pass is received by Konan Ndri (Lecce), who makes a yard for himself on the edge of the box, but his poorly placed shot sails well over the bar.
90' There will be a minimum of 7 min. of added time.
88' Davide Nicola has decided to make a change. Francesco Folino (Cremonese) replaces Tommaso Barbieri.
88' Franco Vazquez (Cremonese) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Matteo Bianchetti.
87' Ball possession – 50:50.
85' Antonino Gallo (Lecce) is rightly booked by the referee because it could not have been anything other than a yellow card.
84' Riccardo Sottil (Lecce) sends a beautiful cross into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence manages to clear the ball to safety.
83' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Matteo Bianchetti (Cremonese) was quite harsh and Giuseppe Mucera didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
83' Tommaso Barbieri (Cremonese) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.
78' 2 - 0 It's a goal! Antonio Sanabria (Cremonese) gets on the end of a pass and it allows him to finish into an empty net with a close-range header. The score has changed to 2:0.
77' Eusebio Di Francesco has decided to substitute Ylber Ramadani and he is replaced by Mohamed Kaba (Lecce).
77' It is time for a substitution. Alex Sala (Lecce) is on for Medon Berisha.
75' My Gran could have done better! Alessio Zerbin (Cremonese) got himself in a great position on the edge of the box after a pass, but put his shot well wide of the left post.
74' Alessio Zerbin (Cremonese) sends over a cross from the side into the penalty area in order to find one of his teammates, but he fails and the opportunity goes begging.
74' Davide Nicola decides to make a substitution. Federico Bonazzoli will be replaced by Antonio Sanabria (Cremonese).
73' The fouls committed statistics – 10:9.

67' Eusebio Di Francesco prepares a substitution. Santiago Pierotti is replaced by Konan Ndri (Lecce).
67' Substitution. Nikola Stulic walks off the pitch and Francesco Camarda (Lecce) comes on as a substitute.
66' Martin Payero (Cremonese) jumps above the defenders in order to convert a lofted cross with a nice header. Wladimiro Falcone makes a reflexive save to block his effort from hitting the net.
65' The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Cremonese.

58' Lassana Coulibaly (Lecce) commits a rough challenge and Giuseppe Mucera blows his whistle for a foul.
56' The ball is in the net but it’s immediately ruled out by referee Giuseppe Mucera due to a foul, much to the disappointment of the Federico Baschirotto (Cremonese) and his team.
56' The linesman makes the right call and Cremonese will have a corner.
53' 1 - 0 Federico Bonazzoli (Cremonese) steps up and confidently powers his spot-kick into the bottom right corner.
52' Federico Bonazzoli (Cremonese) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.
51' Here comes the VAR decision: PENALTY to Cremonese!

49' Play continues despite the shouts by some Cremonese players for a penalty. Wait! Referee Giuseppe Mucera interrupts the game right now and he will review that decision using VAR! Let's see what happens.

45+2' Cremonese failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
45+1' Lassana Coulibaly (Lecce) has picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue.
45+1' Warren Bondo (Cremonese) is moving okay again after that injury scare.

43' Medon Berisha (Lecce) floats the free kick into the box, but it's easily cleared by the first man.
42' Federico Baschirotto (Cremonese) deprives his opponent of the ball, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. He's not happy with the decision! Lecce win a free kick.
40' 1:1 – this is the current number of shots on target.
38' A clumsy foul by Santiago Pierotti (Lecce) and Giuseppe Mucera blows his whistle.

35' A sweet pass finds Martin Payero (Cremonese) on the edge of the box, and he drills the ball towards the middle of the goal. Wladimiro Falcone is almost caught out but pulls off a brilliant save at the last second.
33' Medon Berisha (Lecce) plays in a hopeful cross, but it doesn't find its way to any of the attacking players.
32' Medon Berisha (Lecce) collects a sweet pass on the edge of the box and in one movement smashes a shot in on goal, but it balloons high over the bar.
30' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by Lameck Banda (Lecce), is intercepted by the opposition's defence.
29' PENALTY APPEAL after Lameck Banda (Lecce) goes down under a challenge from the defender. All players chase the referee but he's not interested in the penalty claim. Play continues.
27' Antonino Gallo (Lecce) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
27' Neat passing move from Cremonese in order to create new attacking opportunities.
25' Antonino Gallo (Lecce) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
23' The linesman points to the corner flag, Lecce are going to take it.
22' Matteo Bianchetti (Cremonese) touches the ball with his hand. That's a free kick to Lecce.
21' Martin Payero (Cremonese) goes down under a challenge in the box, but the ref immediately waves away the appeals from all players.
20' The ball possession is 44:56.
19' Lameck Banda (Lecce) clearly handles the ball, but he is surprised when the referee blows his whistle.
19' Matteo Bianchetti (Cremonese) seems to have picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue playing.
17' The game is interrupted now, Matteo Bianchetti (Cremonese) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
17' Lameck Banda (Lecce) hasn't suffered any serious injury which would see him leave the pitch. He's back in the game now.
16' Lameck Banda (Lecce) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
15' A short pass finds Filippo Terracciano (Cremonese). He spots the keeper off his line and shoots from mid-range, but the ball sails high over the bar.
11' The corner is swung in but Lecce can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.

8' Lassana Coulibaly (Lecce) timed his run perfectly to connect with the resulting corner kick, but his finish from around the penalty spot was rather poor as it went well wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Cremonese will have a goal kick.
7' Lecce will have a chance to score from a corner kick.

7' Medon Berisha (Lecce) connected with a pass around the edge of the box, aimed and shot. His attempt went towards the middle of the target, but Emil Audero was alert and the score remains the same. The ball goes behind for a corner. Lecce will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
7' Tommaso Barbieri (Cremonese) makes a rough challenge and Giuseppe Mucera blows his whistle for a foul.
6' The ball is cleared after Santiago Pierotti (Lecce) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
4' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Antonino Gallo (Lecce).

2' Nikola Stulic (Lecce) finds space inside the box to shoot after collecting a short pass, but it's a wasted effort as it flies high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Cremonese.

1' Lassana Coulibaly (Lecce) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it. The referee and the linesman both signal a throw-in for Lecce.
1' The first half has started.
